title.narrative: Strengthening International Mediation Capacities ¿ Support to the United Nations Standby Team of Senior Mediation Advisers

description.narrative: The project supports to the UN Standby Team of Senior Mediation Advisers. It foresees the recruitment of several high-level mediation experts (e.g. on mediation process; gender and inclusion) and the deployment of these experts to support senior UN, EU and other mediators, but also support to track II and III mediation efforts, anywhere in the world at short notice.
